I was receiving glitches where it would lose count of the stage I was at and it would take me back to before I prestiged, but only very shortly, then it would black out and it would kick me out of the game again. Finally, I went back on the game, and it had taken me to before I prestiged, but with the pop-up that says “Make account to restore progress.” I did not do this, and the game crashed shortly after. I went back on, and it erased all my progress, leaving me to stage 1, on the tutorial. 

Thank you for reading this, and I really want to get my game back.

reviews.title: They cater to the whales now
reviews.text:

Lately that has changed. Abyssal tournaments are won exclusively by whales, and most recently they released a pet dungeon that only the biggest whales ever had a prayer of completing. I happened to have saved up a lot of diamonds since I never spend them, but I spent over 12,000 diamonds buying pets to push deeper into the dungeon and still didn’t reach the end before the event ended. Mind you, 6,500 diamonds costs $50 in the store. So basically they gave us a dungeon that costs over $100 to complete, and F2P players have no chance of even getting close. 

If you’re an F2P player then don’t waste your time. This game has sold its soul to the whales.

reviews.text: This game is great for something to check throughout the day, burn off some steam on your lunch break, after dinner, before bed ETC. the leveling rewards you like you would hope an RPG would, and I love that it’s not a pay to win type either. Daily challenges make for even more reason to come back and work towards a goal. And if you get stuck you can prestige keeping all your items and skills. Give it a shot, but don’t decide to early give it a couple days to really see how the progression feels To you.

reviews.title: Inactivity
reviews.text: I really like this game, but a lot of players are inactive on it. That’s a problem because some of the inactive individuals are the ones running the clans, specifically, the people who start the clan raid events. I think that if a grandmaster isn’t on the game for at least 2 weeks, the grandmaster title should default to the next player with the most raid tickets only until the grandmaster comes back. This way, the more active players can continue with the raids, and the clans don’t have to be as dead. Please consider this!

reviews.title: Great Game
reviews.text: This game is probably one of the best games I’ve played. when I first started playing it I was a low level and wonder how i could level up and then every time I started attacking a monster, i leveled up my attack and it got faster then I kept upgrading stuff and buying new heroes then it got better and better and now I’m probably gonna get max level because of the upgrades and stuff. I hope people find this game and play it because it’s a great game.

reviews.title: Update v2.9.4 Bug
reviews.text: I am rating the game a 3 star because of two inconveniences, one of them just happened to me this update and it is that my game does not recognize that I installed the update so it tells me to go back to the App Store to update my game to be able to play, and secondly from time to time I get bugs when dumping in percentage relics into an artifact where I lose more than the intended number of relics I choose yo sacrifice to upgrade my artifact. Concluding this review I can say that the game does a good job of keeping players entertained through different complex game mechanics such as skill trees to experiment on and equipments to collect. So keep tapping tappers!

reviews.title: Real life problems.
reviews.text: Oh my god, my sweet god, my fingers hurt. In a time dominated by fidget spinners, people have to ask themselves the question: "what if there was an exponential growth based reward and progression system linked to my obsessive compulsive physical ticks?" This game answers that question by teaching you the meaning of pain as you lose track of time drumming away at your communication device while simultaneously giving yourself a reason to cringe anytime the tips of your fingers come into contact with a solid object. The colors are pretty, too.

reviews.title: Too many updates
reviews.text: This game is fun no doubt Iv been playing since tap Titan 1 and I'm at level 5000. Where this game lost it for me is they update too quickly . Each time there is an update you usually have to reset your skills and figure out the best build to progress . This includes spending tons of diamonds to reset skills and find the best build. As soon as you find it, they reset and change it. They basically use you as a beta tester and you end up wasting tons of diamonds . Slow down the updates, and make sure they work before you go live. Stop using us to see what works and what doesn't.

reviews.title: Not just a childhood game.
reviews.text: This is an idle game, which obviously means you gain money while offline. This is also a game that you can play while listening to music because it actually has some form of play, instead of those stupid games that have you playing constantly or not playing at all. This game was so cool when I was 4, and it’s even better now that I’m 13. I love it, and genuinely recommend you get the game if you haven’t already.

reviews.title: Got disappointing. Don’t invest your time.
reviews.text: Been playing the game for years now and it’s gone through its share of changes but recently, the changes have been more frustrating than helpful or entertaining. Tournaments don’t last 24 hours anymore, which is crazy annoying. Aside from the match making being less than stellar, the enthusiasm for this game has just completely vanished. The time change effected when the tournaments start, so now it’s almost impossible to join tournaments. Loved the game and now I’m just kinda stuck playing it. Invested too much time on the game and now I just wanna uninstall the game. Figured I’d leave a review to warn people not to waste their time on it.

reviews.title: Fix your glitches.
reviews.text: It’s a super fun game and it’s nice to play something where you have a bunch of mechanics to look after and strategize throughout the game. It just blows severely when you go to click on an Ad Fairy to get a boost or perk or whatever she’s giving out, only for the ad to not play/malfunction/freeze the app and then you don’t get the reward. The fairies come frequently enough so the reward you wanted will come back EVENTUALLY but it would be nice to not have to worry about if and when that app freeze is going to happen. And it happens a lot with the Ad Fairies.

reviews.title: Not getting inactive gold
reviews.text: I would give a 5 star rating if I was able to get inactive gold, that’s the only thing that doesn’t make me rate this a 5 star. I was a prestige 5 or 6 and I would be gone for the night and would come back in the morning and I didn’t get my inactive gold, and the next day or I’ll be gone for a few hours and no inactive gold. And it became harder to upgrade heroes if I don’t get any gold, then the game got boring and I deleted it. I just recently reinstalled it and I’m still not getting any inactive gold.

reviews.title: Buggy update
reviews.text:

I will update this review if the devs fix the bugs and replace my missing artifact or relics.

reviews.title: Updates... Sigh
reviews.text: The game is a lot of fun and working with the social/clan concept is simple. Like any game that adds a social aspect the co-op piece is what you choose to make of it. The only major detractor from this game is the updates. They never seem to be ready on the store when the server switches to lock you out if you haven’t updated. It’s a serious frustration. I don’t play a lot of games and this is one that I’ve enjoyed as my fidgety time filler app. Hope that the devs can get a little more streamlined on the times to get the updates to market in tandem with the servers.

reviews.title: STOP IGNORING TAP TITANS 1 YOU PRICKS

reviews.title: A great way to pass time
reviews.text: This game is visually pleasing with its smooth animations and bright (but not garish) color palette for its cel shaded animation type. Mechanics are easy to figure out, but have levels of complexity that help to raise it above other “tap to make numbers go up” games. For a treat, read the backstories of the dozens of heroes you get to recruit. Also, while there is premium currency you can buy with real dollars, I’ve never felt like I was required to spend money in order to play the game. All in all, a real treat.

reviews.title: Good game but there are some problems
reviews.text: It’s a good game and it’s very addictive, but one thing bothers me a lot. I have seen in other people’s reviews that the mana takes too long to reload. Some of the bosses are too hard so I have to use the powers but I don’t have enough mana so I have to tap a lot to beat them. Also, when the fairy comes for your bonus and you collect it, the ad pops up but my game is still going on in the background, and the boss that I was fighting beats me and I have to fight him over again. Please fix those in the next update

reviews.title: 2.0 killed it
reviews.text: Update 2.0 came out for the game and has completely ruined it.  This is a numbers game and the numbers are terrible.  Heroes are worthless, it’s only about tapping now.  Leveling up means absolutely nothing other than every 40 level ups you get a 10x damage boost.  One tap kills every titan.  I played the first Tap Titans for months and had a great time with it.  Coming into this game a few days before 2.0, I was excited to get back to that nostalgia.  Then 2.0 dropped, and while I was struggling to get past level 100 or so, I could suddenly one-tap my way all the way to level 850 before resetting even once.  Could be a great game, but they put through an update with what seems like no actual testing.

reviews.title: Awesome game
reviews.text: The game isn’t at all pay to win. It doesn’t have advertisements in your face every second. It’s an amazing game when it comes to simple graphics and fun. reviews.title: Good Game, Needs Work
reviews.text: I loved the first game. I had nearly two hundred hours in on a separate account. This second one echoes many things from the first, including the upgrading and update tabs. However, where the first game was simple, this one practically plays itself. Adds are too frequent- while optional, it’s hard to say no to a billion gold each video. Too many new options have been added for my taste, including options for multiplayer and a shop- the shop, in particular, I find abhorrent. I was overjoyed to find this game again, but overall, I feel a touch soured.

reviews.title: Good Game; Very Engaging
reviews.text: I think that tap titans 2 is a game that I will likely play for much longer. It’s style of art is good, the story lines of the characters are well made, and the satisfaction of prestige is incredible when I get to use all my relics and skill points. One other big factor is the clans, where I can chat and play with all of my other friends. I give this game a 5 star for being not only one of the best games on my phone, but so other people may find this game too.
